lore.desc: Skýjakot, often derisively called 'The Rattle' by locals, is less a 'Cloud House' and more a survivalist rig bolted to the spine of the world. While it escapes the suffocating darkness of the Gryning forest floor, the city is a marvel of brute-force engineering; massive, rusting hydraulic clamps grip the ancient sequoia-like pines, stabilizing the city against gale-force winds. The sleek glass of the original design is now reinforced with steel mesh, and the 'Undercanopy' below has become a graveyard of dropped machinery—a dark zone where only scavengers dare to tread.
